user.title: Connect to a Cast device by static IP
user.description: Enter the speaker's literal IPv4 address. Reserve this address in your router so it does not change. UUID is normally detected automatically; enter the UUID from a PyChromecast log only if automatic device information cannot be read. This integration does not use mDNS or .local names.

reconfigure.title: Update the Cast device IP address
reconfigure.description: Enter the new IPv4 address. The device UUID must match the existing device.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to a Cast device at this address. Check the IP address and TCP port 8009.
error.different_device: This IP address belongs to a different Cast device.
error.invalid_cast_device: The device did not return a valid Google Cast UUID.
error.invalid_ip: Enter a literal IPv4 address, for example 192.168.1.50.
error.invalid_uuid: Enter a valid UUID, for example 19fdb31c-52ca-89c2-cc5a-8e8b7b7cf202.
error.uuid_mismatch: The entered UUID does not match the Cast device at this address.
error.uuid_required: Port 8009 is reachable, but device information could not be read. Enter the UUID shown in the PyChromecast log.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while connecting to the Cast device.

abort.already_configured: This Cast device is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The Cast device was reconfigured successfully.

init.title: Connection settings
init.description: The client retries forever. Retry delay is the initial delay; PyChromecast increases it after repeated failures. Socket timeout controls each connection attempt.

not_connected.message: The Cast speaker is not connected. The integration will continue retrying automatically.
